name: tasks
description: Even Keel's own tasks server for sessions on any of its trackers (built-in, Huly, GitHub, Linear, Jira, GitLab, Forgejo): five tools (tasks_list, task_read, tasks_create, task_update, task_comment) with short Markdown answers, tasks by key and labels, milestones and statuses by name, description patches instead of resending it, no deletes; and the task and split skills. Even Keel's MCP gateway answers it in the service: a chain session gets it through the project's packages with its own task in the prompt, a session started by hand reaches http://127.0.0.1:4748/tasks and names the project by its key.
